items.title: Awesome Data Engineering
items.content_text:
### Data Ingestion

*   [Renart (⭐96)](https://github.com/renart-data/renart) - Local-first IDE for authoring and running SQL and Python data pipelines stored in Git.
*   [OLake (⭐1.6k)](https://github.com/datazip-inc/olake) - Open-source replication of Postgres, MySQL, MongoDB, Oracle, SQL Server, DB2, Kafka and S3 into Apache Iceberg, with CDC and table maintenance. Written in Go.
*   [Firecrawl (⭐200k)](https://github.com/firecrawl/firecrawl) - Open-source web data API that scrapes, crawls, maps, and searches the web and returns Markdown or structured JSON for data pipelines and LLM ingestion.
*   [mq-bridge (⭐25)](https://github.com/marcomq/mq-bridge) - Embeddable Rust engine and CLI that moves data between Kafka, NATS, RabbitMQ, MQTT, SQL databases, Postgres/MongoDB CDC and Parquet on S3/GCS/Azure, with bindings for Python and Node.js.

### Serialization format

*   [SequenceFile](https://cwiki.apache.org/confluence/display/HADOOP2/SequenceFile) - A flat file consisting of binary key/value pairs. It is extensively used in MapReduce as input/output formats.

### Stream Processing

*   [Spring Cloud Dataflow](https://dataflow.spring.io/) - Streaming and tasks execution between Spring Boot apps.
*   [Timeplus Proton (⭐2.3k)](https://github.com/timeplus-io/proton) - Streaming SQL engine in a single C++ binary, powered by ClickHouse; a lightweight alternative to Flink and ksqlDB for streaming ETL, windowed aggregations, joins and materialized views over Kafka.
*   [CardinalityEstimation (⭐100)](https://github.com/saguiitay/CardinalityEstimation) - C# library using HyperLogLog for approximate distinct counting in data streams, with mergeable estimators and serialization.

### Charts and Dashboards

*   [SmoothieCharts (⭐2.3k)](https://github.com/joewalnes/smoothie) - A JavaScript Charting Library for Streaming Data.
*   [Streamlit](https://streamlit.io/) - An open-source Python framework for building interactive data apps and dashboards with minimal code. Connects to any data source and supports real-time updates, caching, and one-click deployment.
*   [GeoSQL (⭐684)](https://github.com/dekart-xyz/geosql) - Claude/Codex skill for cost-safe geospatial SQL on BigQuery and Snowflake.

### Workflow

*   [Cascading](https://cascading.wensel.net/) - Java based application development platform.
*   [Dataform (⭐1k)](https://github.com/dataform-co/dataform) - An open-source framework and web based IDE to manage datasets and their dependencies. SQLX extends your existing SQL warehouse dialect to add features that support dependency management, testing, documentation and more.
*   [Ciaren (⭐37)](https://github.com/ciaren-labs/Ciaren) - A local-first visual ETL and ML workflow builder with per-step previews, cron scheduling, and export to pandas or Polars code.

### Datasets / Data Dumps

*   [OpenChainBench](https://openchainbench.com) - Live dataset of crypto infrastructure benchmarks (RPC latency, oracle deviation, bridge fees, L1 finality, perp DEX metrics). Open methodology, CC BY 4.0, Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20800312. [Source (⭐9)](https://github.com/ChainBench/OpenChainBench).

### Profiling / Data Profiler

*   [dataprof (⭐33)](https://github.com/AndreaBozzo/dataprof) - Data profiling and quality gates for CSV, JSON, Parquet, DataFrames and Arrow tables, with a Rust core and a Python API.
*   [Dex (⭐116)](https://github.com/exmergo/dex) - Agent-native warehouse profiling, join verification, and schema-drift detection with dbt transformation workflows.

### Testing / Data Profiler

*   [DataOps TestGen (⭐81)](https://github.com/DataKitchen/dataops-testgen) - Open-source data quality tool that profiles tables, generates validation tests from the profiling results, and monitors freshness, volume, and schema from a web UI.
*   [Data Contract CLI](https://cli.datacontract.com) - Tests data in Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Kafka and other sources against data contracts in the Open Data Contract Standard (ODCS), and converts contracts to and from SQL DDL, dbt, Avro and JSON Schema.

### Community / Conferences

*   [Data Council](https://www.datacouncil.ai/) - The first technical conference that bridges the gap between data scientists, data engineers and data analysts.

items.title: Awesome Design Systems
items.content_text:
### More resources

*   [House standard](https://design.inadram.studio/house-standard/) - Catalogue of 103 frontend interaction practices, each with a demo running live in the page that switches between the practice held and the practice broken, and an implementation brief written to be handed to a coding agent. Seventeen of them also ship as a read-only audit plugin.

### Integrations

*   [figma-maxxing (⭐12)](https://github.com/thiagoxikota/figma-maxxing) - Agent skills for real Figma files: Plugin API gotchas, checks before and after every write, comments to verified fixes, handoff gate.

### Unit & Regression test / Storybook addons

*   [pixelpact (⭐16)](https://github.com/jamalkamaladdin/pixelpact) - CLI and MCP server that extracts a visual contract (sizes, spacing, typography, states, animation, design tokens) from a live page or Figma frame, then checks an implementation against it and reports every value that drifted.

items.title: Awesome Testing
items.content_text:
### Software / Service Virtualization

*   [Buggregator (⭐1.1k)](https://github.com/buggregator/server) - Local debugging server with a mock server (OpenAPI import), HTTP request capture and a fake SMTP server whose API waits for an email and extracts one-time codes.

### Software / Test Automation Frameworks

*   [blastradius (⭐13)](https://github.com/baokhang83/blastradius) - Test impact analysis for JVM projects (Maven, Gradle, JUnit 5) that runs only the tests affected by a change, using class dependencies recorded by a Java agent.

### Software / Static Analysis

*   [test-inventory (⭐4)](https://github.com/Huldoser/test-inventory) - Extract declared tests, states and skip reasons from JavaScript and TypeScript source without running the suite, and compare saved inventories between revisions.

items.title: Awesome Python
items.content_text:
### Projects / AI and Agents

*   Code Sandboxes
    *   [pydantic-monty (⭐8.8k)](https://github.com/pydantic/monty) - A secure Python sandbox written in Rust for running AI-written code.

### Projects / Machine Learning

*   Experiment Tracking
    *   [mlflow (⭐29k)](https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow) - An open-source platform for tracking experiments, managing models, and evaluating LLM apps.

### Projects / WebSocket

*   WebRTC
    *   [aiortc (⭐5.1k)](https://github.com/aiortc/aiortc) - A WebRTC and ORTC implementation for asyncio, with audio, video, and data channels.

### Projects / Testing

*   Benchmarking
    *   [pytest-benchmark (⭐1.5k)](https://github.com/ionelmc/pytest-benchmark) - A pytest fixture for benchmarking code.

### Projects / Debugging Tools

*   Debuggers
    *   [debugpy (⭐2.5k)](https://github.com/microsoft/debugpy) - A Debug Adapter Protocol debugger for Python, used by VS Code for remote debugging.
    *   [ipdb (⭐2k)](https://github.com/gotcha/ipdb) - IPython-enabled [pdb](https://docs.python.org/3/library/pdb.html).
    *   [pudb (⭐3.2k)](https://github.com/inducer/pudb) - A full-screen, console-based Python debugger.

### Projects / File Manipulation

*   Remote Files
    *   [fsspec (⭐1.4k)](https://github.com/fsspec/filesystem_spec) - A unified filesystem interface for local, cloud, and remote storage.
    *   [smart-open (⭐3.5k)](https://github.com/piskvorky/smart_open) - Stream files from S3, GCS, Azure, HDFS, and HTTP as a drop-in replacement for open().

### Projects / Built-in Classes Enhancement

*   Class Boilerplate
    *   [dataclasses](https://docs.python.org/3/library/dataclasses.html) - (Python standard library) Adds generated special methods such as `__init__()` and `__repr__()` to your classes.
    *   [attrs (⭐5.9k)](https://github.com/python-attrs/attrs) - Writes `__init__`, `__eq__`, `__repr__`, and other boilerplate methods for your classes.

### Projects / Web Security

*   [flask-cors (⭐933)](https://github.com/corydolphin/flask-cors) - A Flask extension for handling Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS).
*   [django-cors-headers (⭐5.6k)](https://github.com/adamchainz/django-cors-headers) - Handles Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) headers for Django apps.

items.title: Free for Dev
items.content_text:
### APIs, Data, and ML

*   [nosocial Embed API](https://nosocial.eu/api-docs) - A free API for developers to embed public posts from X, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Bluesky, Threads, Facebook, Telegram, Reddit, and LinkedIn on their websites. It returns the embed HTML and any required scripts as JSON. No API key and no request limits.

### Messaging and Streaming

*   [notifysphere.net](https://notifysphere.net/) - All-in-one Customer Engagement and Automation Tool ( push notifications, whatsapp messages, helpdesk, tracker link and events tracking) for SaaS. Free for up to 1,000 active users per month.

### Forms

*   [staticforms.dev](https://www.staticforms.dev/) - Integrate HTML forms easily without any server-side code for free. After the user submits the form, an email with the form content will be sent to your registered address.

### DNS

*   [DNSvivo](https://dnsvivo.com/) - Free managed DNS with automatic failover, weighted load balancing, and Dynamic DNS (DDNS). Includes 2 domains, 5 IP addresses monitored from 5 locations, and 3 DDNS records.

### IaaS

*   [InstaBox](https://instabox.sh/) - Cloud Linux machine for AI agents and developers, running on Firecracker microVMs with Docker and common toolchains preinstalled. Free plan: one 4 vCPU / 8 GiB machine, 20 GiB disk, 5 snapshots and 100 GiB egress per month, no credit card required. Not a persistent VPS: a free machine pauses after 30 minutes idle and runs at most 8 hours per session.

items.title: Awesome Gemini Cli
items.content_text:
### Commands & Extensions

*   [tech-to-motion (⭐1)](https://github.com/georgesmomo/tech-to-motion) - Agent Skill that runs in Gemini CLI and other agents (`npx skills add georgesmomo/tech-to-motion`). Turns a docker-compose, Kubernetes manifests, Terraform, a CI workflow or a postmortem into a motion-design explainer video with animated architecture diagrams and synthesised sound, rendered locally with Hyper
*   [idea-to-motion (⭐0)](https://github.com/georgesmomo/idea-to-motion) - Agent Skill that runs in Gemini CLI and other agents (`npx skills add georgesmomo/idea-to-motion`). Turns any idea into a motion-design video (MP4) with procedural music, synthesised sound effects and an optional local voice-over with captions; asks up to 3 questions only when the brief is incomplete. 14 styles, rendered locally with HyperFrames, no API key.Frames.
*   [Publora (⭐2)](https://github.com/publora-team/gemini-cli-publora) - Gemini CLI extension that schedules and publishes social media posts to LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Threads, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, Bluesky, Mastodon and Telegram through the hosted Publora MCP server, with browser sign-in. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/publora-team/gemini-cli-publora`.

### MCP Servers

*   [KaijuConverter MCP](https://kaijuconverter.com/api/mcp) - Remote Model Context Protocol server enabling AI agents to convert files and datasets across 100+ formats (documents, images, audio, video). Works with Gemini CLI: `gemini mcp add --transport http kaiju https://kaijuconverter.com/api/mcp`.
*   [Shotboard (⭐2)](https://github.com/freeman14/shotboard-mcp) - Local MCP server built into Shotboard, a closed-source Mac app for marketing content, plus a Gemini CLI extension manifest. Lets Gemini CLI search Meta and TikTok ads, extract scripts from links, and generate images, video and audio with 100 media models while the app is open. Connect with `gemini mcp add --transport http -s user --trust shotboard http://127.0.0.1:4317/mcp`.
*   [Datacircle](https://datacircle.dev) - Find the best GTM APIs. Our MCP server is open to anyone, with no key: add api.datacircle.dev/mcp to Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor.
